name: Velex Nano-Thread Self-Repair Jeans
description: Dark-wash slim-taper jeans woven with a low-density nano-thread lattice that slowly closes small tears and fraying over 12–24 hours. The effect is subtle — you won't watch it happen — but minor scuffs and splits seal themselves. Comes in charcoal, midnight indigo, and washed black.
functionality: Passive nano-thread self-repair closes tears under 3cm; does not restore fabric lost to wear-through
what_it_says: You're practical enough to invest in something that lasts. Not rich, but not replacing jeans every season either.
worn_by: anyone who wants jeans that don't fall apart
story_hooks: The nano-thread in a particular batch was sourced from a military contract surplus — the repair rate is three times faster than advertised.
Someone notices their jeans sealed around a small tracking device sewn into a seam by a third party.
